    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    // §50 SHARE50 metrics: a distinct schema so a shared-source run is never
    // confused with the ordinary NATURAL-JSON.  Every field is a real counter
    // or RTL observable from this run; nothing is synthesised.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    void nat_report_share_json(uint32_t beats) {
#ifdef ACTUAL_DMA_SYSTEM
        const long v_delta =
            (nat_hw_v_issue_cycle >= 0 && nat_hw_v_done_cycle >= 0)
            ? (nat_hw_v_done_cycle - nat_hw_v_issue_cycle) : -1;
        const long a_delta =
            (nat_hw_a_issue_cycle >= 0 && nat_hw_a_done_cycle >= 0)
            ? (nat_hw_a_done_cycle - nat_hw_a_issue_cycle) : -1;
        std::printf("SHARE50-JSON {"
            "\"schema\":\"share50-v1\","
            "\"natural\":1,\"shared_source\":%d,\"mode\":%u,"
            "\"natural_bytes\":%llu,\"want_beats\":%llu,"
            "\"detached\":%d,\"cut_bytes\":%llu,\"cut_beats\":%llu,"
            "\"parents\":%u,"
            "\"v_rbytes\":%llu,\"a_rbytes\":%llu,"
            "\"v_wbytes\":%llu,\"a_wbytes\":%llu,"
            "\"src_ar_bursts\":%llu,\"src_r_beats\":%llu,"
            "\"v_dst_w_beats\":%llu,"
            "\"v_issue_to_done\":%ld,\"a_issue_to_done\":%ld,"
            "\"quiet_seen\":%d,\"deferred_resumed\":%d,"
            "\"pause_mode\":%u,\"pause_require_quiet\":%d,"
            "\"memory_b_delay\":%u,\"memory_backpressure\":%u}\n",
            (int)shared_source, (unsigned)task_physical_bypass,
            (unsigned long long)natural_bytes, (unsigned long long)beats,
            (int)top->dbg_shared_detached,
            (unsigned long long)top->dbg_shared_cut_bytes,
            (unsigned long long)(top->dbg_shared_cut_bytes / 8),
            (unsigned)top->dbg_shared_parents,
            (unsigned long long)top->dbg_pause_v_rbytes,
            (unsigned long long)top->dbg_pause_a_rbytes,
            (unsigned long long)top->dbg_pause_v_wbytes,
            (unsigned long long)top->dbg_pause_a_wbytes,
            (unsigned long long)nat_par_bursts[NR_VSRC],
            (unsigned long long)nat_pr_beats[NR_VSRC],
            (unsigned long long)nat_pw_beats[NR_VDST],
            v_delta, a_delta,
            (int)pause_quiet_seen,
            (int)(pause_mode > 0 && pause_triggered && pause_end_cycle >= 0),
            (unsigned)pause_mode, (int)pause_require_quiet,
            (unsigned)memory_b_delay, (unsigned)memory_backpressure);
#else
        (void)beats;
#endif
    }
